rows.quote: Genome-wide association study summary data used in this study are available publicly from the GWAS catalog (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/) and FinnGen round 10 (https://www.finngen.fi).The eQTL, and mQTL, sQTL for SMR analysis are available publicly from The Yang Lab platform, Westlake University, China (https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/smr/#Download).
rows.coder_note: Step 2 (rule A): 'FinnGen round 10' is release 10 written with the word round, so FinnGen R10. p001 agrees ('FinnGen Release 1024' is Release 10 followed by the citation marker 24, Kurki 2023); no passage names another release. The 'FinnGen' cell under Validation in Table 2A is a pQTL replication source, not the outcome.

rows.quote: Independence was determined using the OpenGWAS Database API within the ieugwasr R package by excluding linkage disequilibrium (LD) (r2 < 0.001, clumping window > 10,000 kb).26–28 Glaucoma and subtypes (POAG and PACG) data were cross-referenced from FinnGen Release 1024 and the Million Veteran Program.29 The GWAS summary statistics for IOP metrics,30 retinal imaging biomarkers,30 gut microbiota,31 inflammatory factors,32 and lipidome,33 were obtained from the GWAS catalog.
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rule C2): the glaucoma data are from the Million Veteran Program (reference 29, Verma 2024, doi 10.1126/science.adj1182, which is no dictionary row's identifier); the outcome side has no row for the Million Veteran Program GWAS under any release. The only row naming MVP is the FinnGen R12 + MVP + UK Biobank meta-analysis, which the paper does not use: it analyses FinnGen and MVP separately and meta-analyses them itself (Table 1).

Step 1: p002 attributes the UKB-PPP protein GWAS to references 20-22; reference 20 (Eldjarn 2023, doi 10.1038/s41586-023-06563-x) is the source of the Eldjarn 2023 rows and reference 22 (Dhindsa 2023, doi 10.1038/s41586-023-06547-x) is the source of the Dhindsa 2023 exome row, while p005 credits 'Sun et al. GWAS analysis on proteome from UKB-PPP' and p006 gives the whole-deposit identifier syn51364943 (C3, picks no row). The verified citations point to different dictionary rows and no attribute (N, ancestry, subcohort) settles which is used; 'more than 50,000 individuals' is approximate.
